visits.clinician_note:
Complaints & Symptoms:
36-year-old woman presents for routine review. Mentions her clothes no longer fit and she has gained 'a lot of weight' since starting her current HIV medication. Also feels more tired than usual.

Examination Findings:
BP 138/88 mmHg. Weight 82kg. BMI 32.4 kg/m². Waist circumference 96cm. Acanthosis nigricans noted at neck and axillae. No peripheral oedema.

Significant history prior to today's visit:
ART History: Switched from TDF/3TC/EFV (used for 3 years) to TLD 18 months ago due to EFV-related side effects (dizziness and vivid dreams).

Baseline Metrics (at TLD switch): BP was 118/74 mmHg; Weight was 65kg; BMI was 25.6 kg/m²; Fasting glucose was 92 mg/dL.

Comorbidities/Family History: HIV diagnosed 2019. No prior DM or HTN. Family history significant for Type 2 Diabetes (mother).

labs_narrative.narrative_text: Glycemic Markers: Fasting glucose 118 mg/dL (impaired); HbA1c 6.1% (pre-diabetic range). Lipid Profile: Total cholesterol 228 mg/dL, LDL 148 mg/dL, HDL 38 mg/dL, Triglycerides 212 mg/dL. Renal/Virological: Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; Viral load <50 copies/mL; CD4 612 cells/uL.

problems.summary: Weight 65 to 82 kg (BMI 25.6 to 32.4) since moving to TLD: DTG-associated weight gain; diet and exercise

guideline.quote: Although DTG is associated with more weight gain compared to other regimens, it appears to unmask it rather than cause it. There is no role for switching ART regimens in patients who experience significant weight gain on DTG.

problems.summary: Fasting glucose 92 to 118 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.1% (prediabetes) on DTG: glucose monitoring

guideline.quote: Initiate on DTG, glucose monitoring every 3 months for the 1st year

problems.summary: LDL 148, triglycerides 212, HDL 38 mg/dL: dyslipidaemia to manage

guideline.quote: If PLHIV has comorbidities (diabetes mellitus, hypertension) or lifestyle risk factors or on ART for more than five years or is ≥ 45 years
